note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Start the age readers once the ledger lands", the age rules reaching young writers, producers and directors as well as performers; "It should cover across every country"; "Again I want depth covering every basis for every feature leaving NO STONE UNTURNED"): what age changes for screen work in Serbia: the age of majority, the working age, how a minor's contract binds and what of the pay is set aside, a child performer's permit and hours, the unions', the funds' and the company law's ages. Research, retry and web-search subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-ages-roles.md, BRIEF-ages-world.md, BRIEF-ages-search.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: In Serbia a child of fourteen (stariji maloletnik) may make any legal transaction with a parent's prior or later consent (the guardianship authority's for the most important ones); from fifteen he manages and disposes of his own earnings and of property gained by his own work; an employment contract under eighteen needs a parent's written consent and a medical finding that the work suits him. No law read sets a share of earnings aside, and the rules apply to any transaction or employment (writing or directing alike, reading). Majority and full capacity come at eighteen (earlier by marriage with court leave, or by court order from sixteen for a minor parent).

binding.from14: parent's consent (guardianship authority for art. 193(3) transactions)
binding.employmentUnder18: parent's written consent and a medical finding

figures.applies: Porodični zakon arts. 11, 64 and Zakon o radu art. 25, consolidated on Paragraf, read 2026-11-01.

sources.said: Punoletstvo i poslovna sposobnost Član 11 (1) Punoletstvo se stiče sa navršenom 18. godinom života. (2) Potpuna poslovna sposobnost stiče se punoletstvom i sklapanjem braka pre punoletstva uz dozvolu suda. ... (2) Dete koje je navršilo 14. godinu života (stariji maloletnik) može preduzimati, pored pravnih poslova iz stava 1 ovog člana, i sve ostale pravne poslove uz prethodnu ili naknadnu saglasnost roditelja, odnosno saglasnost organa starateljstva za pravne poslove iz člana 193 stav 3 ovog zakona. (3) Dete koje je navršilo 15. godinu života može preduzimati pravne poslove kojima upravlja i raspolaže svojom zaradom ili imovinom koju je steklo sopstvenim radom.

Član 25 Radni odnos sa licem mlađim od 18 godina života može da se zasnuje uz pismenu saglasnost roditelja, usvojioca ili staraoca, ako takav rad ne ugrožava njegovo zdravlje, moral i obrazovanje, odnosno ako takav rad nije zabranjen zakonom. Lice mlađe od 18 godina života može da zasnuje radni odnos samo na osnovu nalaza nadležnog zdravstvenog organa

figures.finding: Serbia has no child-performer permit: employment needs at least fifteen years, with no exception for performing (so a child under fifteen can't be employed to perform, reading); a worker under eighteen works at most 35 hours a week and 8 a day, no overtime, and no night work except in culture, sport, art and advertising. The rule is the general labour law and reaches a young writer or director employed alike (reading).

under18.nightWork: allowed only in culture, sport, art and advertising (among exceptions)

figures.applies: Zakon o radu arts. 24, 87, 88, consolidated on Paragraf.

sources.said: Član 24 Radni odnos može da se zasnuje sa licem koje ima najmanje 15 godina života i ispunjava druge uslove za rad na određenim poslovima ... Član 87 Puno radno vreme zaposlenog mlađeg od 18 godina života ne može da se utvrdi u trajanju dužem od 35 časova nedeljno, niti dužem od osam časova dnevno. Član 88 Zabranjen je prekovremeni rad i preraspodela radnog vremena zaposlenog koji je mlađi od 18 godina života. Zaposleni mlađi od 18 godina života ne može da radi noću, osim: 1) ako obavlja poslove u oblasti kulture, sporta, umetnosti i reklamne delatnosti;

figures.finding: A regular member of the Association of Dramatic Artists of Serbia (UDUS) must be a Serbian citizen working professionally in dramatic art with a degree from a faculty or academy of dramatic arts (or another qualification with professional work), so membership follows training, not an age the rules name.

value.eligibility: citizen, professional, drama degree or equivalent

figures.applies: UDUS's 'how to become a member' page.

sources.said: Redovni član Udruženja može biti državljanin Republike Srbije koji profesionalno deluje na teritoriji Republike Srbije u oblasti dramske umetnosti, ako ispunjava sledeće uslove: 1. da je završio fakultet ili akademiju dramskih umetnosti

figures.finding: The Film Centre of Serbia funds by public competition, twice a year for domestic production; under the Law on Cinematography a producer is a legal person or a registered entrepreneur (preduzetnik), and an entrepreneur must have full legal capacity (see companies), so a minor can't be the producer; an author is any natural person who created the work. The law also tasks the Centre with supporting young authors and debutants.
figures.applies: Zakon o kinematografiji arts. 2, 16 to 18 on Paragraf.

sources.said: 2) autor je fizičko lice koje je stvorilo originalno kinematografsko autorsko delo; 3) producent je pravno lice ili preduzetnik registrovan za organizovanje i finansiranje produkcije kinematografskog dela; ... 3) podržava i podstiče proizvodnju kinematografskih dela mladih autora i debitanata; ... Dva puta godišnje, Centar raspisuje i sprovodi javni konkurs radi prikupljanja predloga za finansiranje ili sufinansiranje projekata proizvodnje domaćih filmova.

figures.finding: An entrepreneur (sole trader) must be a natural person with full legal capacity, as must a director of a joint-stock company; the law sets no capacity rule of its own for a limited company's director, leaving conditions to the founding act; full capacity comes at eighteen (or by marriage with court leave, or court order from sixteen for a minor parent).

value.llcDirector: no statutory capacity rule read; founding act may set conditions
value.basis: full capacity (poslovna sposobnost), Porodični zakon art. 11

figures.applies: Zakon o privrednim društvima arts. 83, 219, 382 on Paragraf.

sources.said: Član 83 Preduzetnik je poslovno sposobno fizičko lice koje obavlja delatnost u cilju ostvarivanja prihoda i koje je kao takvo registrovano u skladu sa zakonom o registraciji. ... Osnivačkim aktom ili odlukom skupštine mogu se odrediti uslovi koje neko lice treba da ispunjava da bi bilo imenovano za direktora. ... Član 382 Direktor može biti svako poslovno sposobno lice.
